subject.title: fix: harden cloud worker admission and remote turns

question: Has Crabbox 0.38.1+ been published and verified through the supported OpenClaw installation channels so this PR can safely make its authoritative AWS inspection contract mandatory?
rationale: The code deliberately converts a missing upstream attestation into admission failure; only the release owner can confirm that the required dependency is actually available to operators before landing.

options.title: Publish, verify, then merge
options.body: Release Crabbox 0.38.1+, verify each supported install path, refresh the PR head, and merge after exact-head checks pass.

options.title: Coordinate a same-window rollout
options.body: Merge only as part of a tightly coordinated Crabbox release window with install-channel verification attached before users can encounter the new requirement.

recommendation.title: Publish, verify, then merge
recommendation.body: Release Crabbox 0.38.1+, verify each supported install path, refresh the PR head, and merge after exact-head checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the related cloud-worker design and authored the merged Crabbox inspection contract that gates this landing.
